verdict.rationale: A government formalities portal could plausibly offer an API with scoped credentials, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no API key or token issuance, let alone scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent. FranceConnect+ login, qualified e-signature certificates and payment delegation are human identity and payment controls, not API credentials. The keyless recherche-entreprises API is a separate state service and offers no scoping.
